manifest_hash_law: SHA-256 of RFC8785 JCS bytes of the exact manifest object

manifests.algorithm: render each closed record as RFC8785 JCS UTF-8; join in event-index order with LF; require exactly one trailing LF
apply contract response_envelope extraction steps and first_error_precedence without constructing duplicate-key objects
outputs: raw tool channel bytes or empty

manifests.algorithm: apply total precedence to extracted tool channel and emit ACCEPTED typed arguments or REJECTED first error
for ACCEPTED only, compute after_state and reduced rational score exactly as contract structural_oracle; never receives assistant text
future publication follows the exact supported platform, threat model, no-replace sequence, directory-fsync boundaries, and mutation-detection semantics in contract publication_contract
outputs: content-addressed committed objects or no eligible output

manifests.algorithm: apply contract recovery states and recompute eligibility after restart from reopened bytes; partial, stale, mismatched, collided, replaced, or directory-unsynced objects are ineligible
source-distinct streaming lexer and relational reducer; no fixture hash allowlist
source-distinct full-buffer parser and independent relation predicates; no fixture hash allowlist
after both validator outputs commit, compare canonical verdict, first_error, and all derived values byte-for-byte

cross_manifest_closure: fixture renderer identity repeated in invocation records, implementation manifests, and evidence receipt must equal the JCS hash of FIXTURE_RENDERER_V3
response extractor identity repeated in response records, implementation manifests, and evidence receipt must equal the JCS hash of RESPONSE_EXTRACTOR_V3

parser identity in the parse record and corresponding implementation manifest/evidence closure must equal the JCS hash of STRUCTURAL_PARSER_V3; a non-dispatch record binds the parse-record hash rather than repeating a parser manifest
transition identity repeated in accepted transition records, implementation manifests, and evidence receipt must equal the JCS hash of TRANSITION_ORACLE_V3
platform identity repeated in implementation manifests and evidence receipt must equal the JCS hash of PUBLICATION_PLATFORM_V3
each source, dependency lock, and interpreter identity repeated by any implementation or validator output must be exactly byte-equal
every referenced schema, request, response, tool-channel, record, artifact, validator output, comparator output, and receipt hash must resolve to exactly one retrievable byte string
